post.description: Check the version again with the current catalogue (or join a pending run).

get.description: The latest run of the version with its results and findings; null if never checked.
Progress of a run as server-sent events: `run` on every change, `end` when settled.

patch.description: Accept, reject, mark fixed or reopen a finding (optimistic concurrency by revision).

get.description: Every check the product runs, what it requires and what it cites.

Precision, recall and timing of the checks on the labelled reference set;
null until the benchmark has been run.

CheckMethod.title: CheckMethod
CheckMethod.description: How a check reaches its verdict.

CheckOut.title: CheckOut
CheckOut.description: A check of the registry as the product describes it.

DetailOut.title: DetailOut
DetailOut.description:
Either a message code with parameters (translated by the client) or
text written by the language model.

LayoutSource.title: LayoutSource
LayoutSource.description: Where page geometry came from: declared by the file or measured from ink.

MetricsOut.title: MetricsOut
MetricsOut.description:
Confusion counts of a group of observations, with the shares derived.

A share is null when there is nothing to count it from: no violation was
reported (precision) or none is labelled (recall), or the checks did not
run at all (see ``errors``).

ModelsOut.title: ModelsOut
ModelsOut.description:
Whether model checks can run: a model API is configured and the corpus
is searchable with its embedding model.

ParseFailureCode.title: ParseFailureCode
ParseFailureCode.description: Stable reasons a version could not be turned into a structure.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description:
Capabilities checked by the application layer.

Roles grant permissions; code never checks role names directly.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable machine-readable ``code``.

QualityOut.title: QualityOut
QualityOut.description:
How the checks did on the labelled reference set, as last measured.

``current`` is false when the catalogue changed after the measurement.
``model`` is null when no model was connected: the model checks were
not measured.

RequisiteKind.title: RequisiteKind
RequisiteKind.description: Document requisites recognised in the text (GOST R 7.0.97-2016, sec. 5).

ResultStatus.title: ResultStatus
ResultStatus.description: The verdict of one check on one document version.

ReviewStatus.title: ReviewStatus
ReviewStatus.description: What the team decided about a finding.

RunFailureCode.title: RunFailureCode
RunFailureCode.description: Stable reasons a whole run could not finish (single checks fail on their own).

RunSummaryOut.title: RunSummaryOut
RunSummaryOut.description: The latest run of a document's latest version, for lists.

UnitKind.title: UnitKind
UnitKind.description: Levels of a Russian federal law, from the outermost.
